title: AP-Ready Invoice
summary: Check corporate AP requirements, send an invoice packet, and see who has the next action.
user: Freelancers and small studios paid by corporate finance departments who need invoices accepted on the first attempt and need to see who has the next action.
current_workaround: Export a PDF, email AP manually, keep PO, tax, and bank details in notes, and chase status through email threads.
smallest_useful_product: Reusable client AP profiles, invoice preflight, branded PDF and email package, secure status link, and escalation timeline.
success_measure: In pilots, 85% of invoices pass the recipient's first AP review and median time-to-first-status drops by 30%.
constraints: Secure bank and tax identifiers, never impersonate an AP system, and make delivery and audit logs exportable.
